Search summaries blend pages, so URLs are the page named in the result; the NHS side-effects subpage was never returned, so its claims are cited to the main NHS page and NHS 111 Wales. Both 'textbook' signposting sentences were not found in NHS text and were rewritten to what was retrieved (NHS: call 111 for extra dose; Boots leaflet: contact a doctor about bruising). The overdose 999/A&E line was wrong as written (NHS says 111 first; 999 or ambulance only when told to go to A&E). 'Can be taken regularly for many years' is kept as a paraphrase of the NHS statement that uses 'safe'; the word safe is not published, reviewer may prefer to drop it. Final article is 4 sections (merged sections 1+2) because cuts left 5 sections short of 110 words; it is about 880 words (sections and FAQs). Removed unverified: toothache/sore-throat list, pregnancy labelling and brain-development studies, SPS breastfeeding line, contraception and driving, heavy-drinking-at-overdose line. Existing medications.json entry not changed; note its text 'gentle on the stomach' and dose figures were not checked here.
